title: Daidaitawa, kula da inganci da aikin ƙwararrun farashi

say: Daidaitawa, kula da inganci, da farashin ƙwararrun ƙwararrun.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don samfura biyar na Advanced Tailoring and Pattern Yin.

Wannan tsarin yana haɗa komai tare a matakin da abokan ciniki ke biyan mafi yawa. Toile shine kayan gwaji da aka dinka daga calico mai nauyin nauyi zuwa masana'anta na ƙarshe. Ainihin dacewa yana faruwa a can, kuma gyare-gyaren suna tafiya akan tsarin.

say: Sa'an nan za ku gina ingancin cak a kowane mataki, da kuma gudanar da aikin abokin ciniki tare da rubutaccen umarni da farashin da za ku iya bayyanawa.

say: Alal misali, Grace a Calabar ya dace da ɗakin bayan gida don rigar kullin yadin da aka saka. Ta fara daga sama. Sake manne kafada 1 cm ƙasa yana cire folds na wuyansa zuwa hannu. A kan ƙirar ta rage ƙananan hannun ta 1 cm kuma, don haka hannun hannu yana kiyaye girmansa.

panel.heading: Alheri ya dace kuma ya canza rigar lace
items: Kafada 1 cm ƙasa; karkashin hannu 1 cm ƙasa
Cikakken tsattsauran ra'ayi: shimfidar gefen gefen 2 cm
Juya baya: ninka fitar da wani yanki na 1.5 cm
Hannun hannu: 36 cm bicep + 3 cm sauƙi = 39 cm
Sake duba sauƙin hula; lanƙwasa zuwa 3 cm

say: Janye fatun ya rage. Ba a tsince su a gefen kabu ba, maɓuɓɓugan bayan gida suna buɗe kusan 2 cm kowane gefe. Don haka ta shimfiɗa gefen gaban panel 2 cm a matakin bust kuma ta ƙara tsayin da ya dace.

say: Rubuta kowane oda akan shafi ɗaya: ƙira, masana'anta, kayan aiki, kwanan watan bayarwa, farashi, ajiya da sharuɗɗan ku. Aika shi akan WhatsApp kuma ka tambayi abokin ciniki ya amsa ya amince. Wannan sakon shine rikodin ku.

panel.heading: Oda da biyan kuɗi, an yi su lafiya

cards.d: Zane, masana'anta, kayan aiki, kwanan watan bayarwa, farashi, ajiya, sharuɗɗan. Abokin ciniki ya amsa 'an yarda' akan WhatsApp.
Duba kowane canja wuri a cikin bankin ku ko aikace-aikacen walat ɗin ku. Za a iya yin karyar hotunan allo da faɗakarwar SMS.
Kada ku taɓa raba OTP ko PIN tare da duk wanda ke da'awar ya fito daga bankin ku.

say: Kafin fitar da tufa, tabbatar da canja wurin a bankin ku ko aikace-aikacen walat ɗin ku. Kar a taɓa dogara ga hoton allo ko faɗakarwar SMS, saboda duka biyun ana iya yin bogi.

say: Don tunawa. Daidaita daga sama zuwa ƙasa, kuma karanta inda layukan ja suka nuna. Gyara tsarin kuma sake gwadawa. Auna a kan rubuce-rubucen haƙuri.
Farashin daga lokaci, kayan aiki, kari da riba. Kuma tabbatar da kowane biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku.
